question: Accept the exact execution-free Stage C directional/nonlocal software-verification package and authorize managed administrative closeout of that implementation boundary only?

options.summary: Accept the exact authored-toy Stage C software package and close it out.
options.consequence: Finalize records and projections, run closeout checks, create one in-scope commit on dev, push it to the configured upstream, verify remote identity, and stop without authorizing an accepted-parent Stage C calculation or Stage D.

options.summary: Do not accept the execution-free Stage C implementation.

recommendation: ACCEPT_EXECUTION_FREE_STAGE_C_AND_AUTHORIZE_MANAGED_CLOSEOUT because the package implements the authorized authored-toy contract, all ten maintained software-verification tests pass, the independent verifier reconstructs the toy with maximum difference 1.388e-17 E_G, the closed schema and deterministic serialization pass, and the implementation review reports NO_BLOCKING_FINDINGS with one explicit toy-scope limitation.
safe_scope: Accept only the exact execution-free Stage C design, implementation, schema, authored-toy tests, independent reconstruction, documentation, checkpoint records, checksums, Task state, and Harness projections; managed closeout may commit and push only this in-scope boundary to the configured dev upstream.
blocked_scope: Accepted-parent Stage C design or execution, Stage B reruns, Stages D and E, material-specific DFT, production Wannier90, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, material transfer, new dependencies, publication, release, deposit, and external transmission remain unauthorized.
authorized_scope: Accept only the exact execution-free Stage C design, runner, independent verifier, closed schema, authored-toy software-verification tests, implementation review, documentation, checksums, Task state, and Harness projections; run closeout checks; create one non-amended in-scope commit on the current development branch; push that exact commit to its configured upstream and verify remote identity; stop without authorizing accepted-parent Stage C work or activating Stage D.
